title: The Proprium's Generations and the Phases of Regeneration
summary: The cosmic-temporal architecture of regeneration. T14 traces how the proprium consolidates as ruling principle, declares "I have risen up to plant myself," produces its corpses out of itself, and is humbled by the Divine Human; the twelve dignities are the rational's twelvefold articulation into which the soul's claiming is bound. T15 unfolds the five Greatnesses as the Lord's complete going-forth reaching down to Adam and Eve's flesh and returning home in the Last Andrias. T16 establishes the three structural periods of regeneration (descent, formation, return). T17 unfolds the four contests; T18 unfolds the four salvations by which what could not be received at one register is delivered at the next.
organizing_principle: The teachings present the temporal architecture of regeneration: T14-T15 give the proprium's generations balanced against the Lord's twelvefold descent reaching to ultimates; T16 establishes the threefold phasing of cosmic time; T17-T18 unfold the wars and salvations as parallel stages within that phasing — every contest met by a corresponding deliverance. The arc traces cosmic time from descent through structuring to consummation.
